card.name: Inside new brand drug names
card.fires_on: Early or middle pieces of newly coined brand names (VERZENIO, PEMFEXY, OPDIVO, OMCAZIO, ZENBEXUS) in label text. Also the comma after "REMS" in the opioid REMS passage.

modes.label: Brand name pieces
modes.description: A partial piece of an all-caps or capitalized brand name, before the name is finished.

modes.label: Comma after REMS
modes.description: The comma after "requirements of the REMS" in the opioid analgesic REMS text.
modes.example: Under the requirements of the REMS<<,>> drug companies with approved opioid analgesic

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly unrelated Chinese and symbol pieces, and the suppressed ones are approval words, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires partway through unfamiliar brand drug names in labels, and on the comma after REMS.
